subject: Director of Finance and Administration Candidate Interviews
overview: The School Committee reviewed 2016-2017 opening day preparations and referred a five-year capital improvement plan to a committee of the whole. The meeting concluded with public interviews for the Director of Finance and Administration position.

items.title: Opening of School Year and Maintenance Report
items.summary: Superintendent Belson reported on enrollment increases, the implementation of Transfinder software for busing, and district-wide security drills. Maintenance Director McLaughlin detailed summer repairs including painting, sidewalk replacement at the McGlynn and Columbus schools, and new gym flooring.

items.title: Election Security and Administrative Routine
items.summary: The committee discussed police presence and separate entrances for polling stations located in elementary schools for the upcoming September election. Members also corrected the meeting calendar and requested a training session on school board roles from the MASC.

items.title: Five-Year Capital Plan Proposals
items.summary: The committee reviewed a citywide 'wish list' for school facility and technology improvements prioritized by health, safety, and educational impact. The proposal was referred to the committee of the whole for site visits at each school building to refine priorities.

items.title: Director of Finance and Administration Finalist Interviews
items.summary: The committee conducted public interviews with finalists Kirsteen Patterson, Michelle Shepard, and Diane Johnson. Candidates were questioned on their experience with procurement, municipal software conversions, collective bargaining, and student transportation management.
